ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: i2c
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Interrupt status, enable, and test registers for a single I2C controller and target.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Controller TX FIFO level is less than `HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.FMT_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Controller RX FIFO level is greater than `HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.RX_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Target RX FIFO level is greater than `TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG.ACQ_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller RX FIFO overflows. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_HALT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while this controller halts. The flags in the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS` register explain the reason(s) for the halting. Clearing the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS` flags clears this interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when SCL is unexpectedly pulled LOW by another controller. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when SDA is unexpectedly pulled LOW by another controller. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STRETCH_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the target stretches the clock longer than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL` (valid only when `TIMEOUT_CTRL.MODE = 0`). Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_UNSTABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the target fails to keep SDA stable during a transmission. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_COMPLETE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller/Target Mode interrupt: asserted when this/the controller finishes generating a STOP or repeated START. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while this target is stretching the clock or has halted. The flags in the `TARGET_EVENTS` register explain the reason(s) for clock stretching/halting. Clearing the `TARGET_EVENTS` flags clears this interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Target TX FIFO level is less than `TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG.TX_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the target is stretching the clock because 1) the Target RX FIFO is full or 2) the `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` count has reached `0` (only if `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNEXP_STOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the controller sends this target a STOP before this target NACKs. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HOST_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the controller stops generating the clock longer than `HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when `smbalert_ni` is asserted. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller TX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller RX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the Target TX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the Target RX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SMBUS_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SMBus Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBSUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: asserts the `smbsus_no` output.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: asserts the `smbalert_no` output. This bit clears itself when the controller addresses this target.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLEHOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: configures this device's operating mode. * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Controller Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Target Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Hybrid Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Monitor Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLETARGET
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: configures this device's operating mode. * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Controller Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Target Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Hybrid Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Monitor Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LLPBK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: enables line loop-back. In Controller Mode, the internal logic sees the `smbalert_ni` input as deasserted. In Target Mode, this target sends all received SDA data back out, and the internal logic sees received data as all 1's.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK_ADDR_AFTER_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: NACK address after timeout. If this bit is: * `0` - This target ACKs the address byte even if a Stretch Timeout occurs (useful for SMBus). * `1` - This target NACKs the address byte when a Stretch Timeout occurs.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACK_CTRL_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: enables the Software ACK Control Mechanism. If this bit is: * `0` - This target ACKs a data byte whenever the ACQ FIFO has space. * `1` - This target ACKs the first `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` bytes. If another byte arrives, this target stretches the clock and awaits software intervention (and asserts `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH`). The software can 1. accept the new byte(s) by reloading the `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` counter; or 2. reject the new byte(s) by writing `1` to `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NACK` (useful for SMBus).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Global control: enables the Bus Monitor. Set this bit to `1` only in a multi-controller environment.
If a `0`->`1` transition happens while `ENABLEHOST` and `ENABLETARGET` are both `0`, the Bus Monitor will enable and begin in the 'Bus Busy' state. To transition to a 'Bus Free' state, `HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL` must be nonzero so the Bus Monitor may count out idle cycles to confirm the freedom to transmit. In addition, the Bus Monitor will track whether the bus is free based on the enabled timeouts and detected STOP symbols. For Multi-Controller Mode, ensure `MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN` becomes `1` no later than `ENABLEHOST` or `ENABLETARGET`. This bit can be set at the same time as either or both of the other two, though.
Note that if `MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN` is set after `ENABLEHOST` or `ENABLETARGET`, the Bus Monitor will begin in the 'Bus Free' state instead. This would violate the proper protocol for a controller to join a multi-controller environment. However, if this controller is known to be the first to join, this ordering will enable skipping the idle wait.
When `0`, the bus monitor will report that the bus is always free, so the Controller FSM is never blocked from transmitting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target mode control: enables the Software TX Stretch Control Mechanism. If this bit is: * `0` - Automatic TX Stretch: When this target receives a READ address byte, it only stretches the clock if the TX FIFO is empty; otherwise, it pops the FIFO and transmits the data byte. The target never sets the `TARGET_EVENTS` register flags in this mode. * `1` - Software TX Stretch Mode: When this target receives a READ address, it always stretches the clock and sets the `TARGET_EVENTS.TX_PENDING` flag. The software can: 1. confirm the release and transmission of the TX FIFO data by writing a 1 to clear the `TARGET_EVENTS.TX_PENDING` flag; or 2. reset the TX FIFO by writing 1 to `FIFO_CTRL.TXRST` and load in new data via the `TXDATA` register--useful whenthe READ address is targeting a different function of the target. In this mode, the target always sets the `TARGET_EVENTS` register flags.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_START_STOP_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ACQ FIFO Start/Stop Enable (Target Mode only): * `0` - Start/Stop symbols are NOT written into the ACQ FIFO. The firmware should rely on `TARGET_EVENTS.START_DETECT` and `TARGET_EVENTS.STOP_DETECT` flags to detect Start/Stop events. * `1` - Start/Stop symbols ARE written into the ACQ FIFO (legacy behavior). When a START (or repeated START) is detected, an `AcqStart` or `AcqRestart` entry is written. When a STOP is detected, an `AcqStop` or `AcqNackStop` entry is written.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller TX FIFO Full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller RX FIFO Full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller TX FIFO Empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HOSTIDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller FSM idle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGETIDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target FSM idle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller RX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target TX FIFO full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target RX FIFO full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target TX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target RX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACK_CTRL_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: indicates that this target is stretching the clock due to the Software ACK Control Mechanism. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller RX FIFO Access Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reading this register pops the Controller RX FIFO.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller TX FIFO Access Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FBYTE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing to this register pushes an entry into the Controller TX FIFO. The meaning of this field depends on the value of the `READB` field: * `READB = 0` - This field is the WRITE data byte. * `READB = 1` - This field specifies the number of bytes to read from the target. Setting this field to 0 reads 256 bytes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: START
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generate a START condition on the bus before sending the byte.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generate a STOP condition on the bus after sending the byte.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read/write: * `0` - Issue WRITE transaction * `1` - Issue READ transaction

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RCONT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read continue/stop: * `0` — Read Stop: The controller NACKs the last data byte. Use this if this is the last READ in a sequence. * `1` — Read Continue: The controller ACKs the last data byte. Use this if this is an intermediate READ in a sequence.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NAKOK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NACK OK. When set, this controller will not care if this byte is NACKed. It will not halt, set the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.NACK` flag, or assert the `CONTROLLER_HALT` Interrupt. This behavior is useful for protocols like Serial Camera Control Bus (SCCB).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FIFO_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: FIFO Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: writing `1` resets the Controller RX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: writing `1` resets the Controller TX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: writing `1` resets the Target RX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: writing `1` resets the Target TX FIFO.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_FIFO_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller FIFO Configuration Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `RX_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Controller RX FIFO level is greater than this setting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `FMT_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Controller TX FIFO level is less than this setting.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target FIFOs Configuration Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `TX_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Target TX FIFO level is less than this setting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `ACQ_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Target RX FIFO level is greater than this setting.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_FIFO_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller FIFOs Status Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller TX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller RX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_FIFO_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target FIFOs Status Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target TX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: OVRD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Override Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXOVRDEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: enables control of the SDA and SCL lines through the `SDA_VAL` and `SCL_VAL` fields, respectively.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCLVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: SCL override value: * `0` - Pull the SCL line low * `1` - Release the SCL line

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDAVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: SDA override value: * `0` - Pull the SDA line low * `1` - Release the SDA line

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bus Oversampled Values Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_RX
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global status: contains the last 16 SCL over-sampled values. LSB is most recent.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_RX
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global status: contains the last 16 SDA over-sampled values. LSB is most recent.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SCL LOW and HIGH Periods Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THIGH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the HIGH period of SCL (`t_HIGH`) in system clock cycles. Must be `≥ 2`. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_HIGH = 4.0 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the LOW period of SCL (`t_LOW`) in system clock cycles. Must be `≥ 2`. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz) minimum `t_LOW = 4.7 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bus Rise and Fall Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_R
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the rise time of SDA and SCL (`t_r`) in system clock cycles. The rise time is measured from 30% to 70% of the signal swing. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s maximum `t_r = 1000 ns` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_F
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the fall time of SDA and SCL (`t_f`) in system clock cycles. The fall time is measured from 70% to 30% of the signal swing. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s maximum `t_f = 300 ns` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING2
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: START Condition Setup and Hold Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_STA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a repeated START condition (`t_SU;STA`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_SU;STA = 4.7 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THD_STA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a (repeated) START condition (`t_HD;STA`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_HD;STA = 4.0 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING3
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Data Setup and Hold Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_DAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the data setup time (`t_SU;DAT`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_SU;DAT = 250 ns` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THD_DAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the data and (N)ACK bits hold time (`t_HD;DAT`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_HD;DAT = 5.0 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING4
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: STOP Condition Setup Time and Bus Free Time Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_STO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a STOP condition (`t_SU;STO`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_SU;STO = 4.0 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_BUF
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the time between a STOP and START condition (`t_BUF`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100kHz)'s `t_BUF = 4.7 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Timeout Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: Specifies the timeout value in system clock cycles. The meaning of this field depends on `MODE`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: timeout mode. * `0` - Stretch Timeout (Controller Mode only). If the target stretches the clock for more time than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`, the `STRETCH_TIMEOUT` interrupt will be asserted. * `1` - Bus Timeout. If SCL is LOW for more time than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`: * In Controller Mode, the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.BUS_TIMEOUT` flag will be asserted, triggering the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. * In Target Mode, the `TARGET_EVENTS.BUS_TIMEOUT` flag will be set, triggering the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timeout Enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target ID Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ADDRESS0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Address 0. This target responds if the 7-bit address matches `ADDRESS0 & MASK0`. `MASK0 = 0x0` disables this address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MASK0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ADDRESS0 mask.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ADDRESS1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Address 1. This target responds if the 7-bit address matches `ADDRESS1 & MASK1`. `MASK1 = 0x0` disables this address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MASK1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ADDRESS1 mask.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ACQDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO Access Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ABYTE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reading this register pops the ACQ FIFO. The meaning of this field depends on `SIGNAL`: * `SIGNAL = 0x0`, `0x1`, `0x3`, `0x4`, or `0x5` - This field contains an address or data byte sent by the controller. * `SIGNAL = 0x2`, `0x6` - This field is meaningless.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SIGNAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
This field indicates if this FIFO entry represents/is associated with control signal(s): * `0x0` - The entry is an ordinary data byte that has been ACKed. * `0x1` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a START. * `0x2` - The entry is a STOP condition following ACKed data bytes. * `0x3` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a repeated START. * `0x4` - The entry is a NACKed data byte. * `0x5` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a (repeated) START. However, the data bytes that followed this address byte were NACKed. * `0x6` - Error. A transaction preceding ended abnormally, for example, due to an unexpected STOP condition, a Bus or Stretch Timeout, a software NACK, or a lost arbitration.
If the FIFO does not have enough space to record a complete transaction, an Error (`0x6`) entry may appear alone.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TXDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target TX FIFO Access Register (Target Mode only).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing to this register pushes data into the Target TX FIFO. The controller reads data from this FIFO during a READ transaction.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller Timeout Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target/Monitor Mode control: controller clock generation timeout value specified in system clock cycles. * Target Mode - If the controller stops generating the clock for more time than this setting, this target asserts the Controller Timeout Interrupt. * Monitor Mode - this field is required to be nonzero for the Bus Monitor to transition out of the initial Busy state. Set this field to `0x0` to disable this behavior.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target Timeout Control Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
When this target has stretched the clock for more time than this setting, this target will NACK incoming data bytes or release the SDA line for outgoing data bytes. The count is cumulative over an entire transaction. In other words, this is SMBus's cumulative target clock extension time.
The behavior for the address byte is configurable via `CTRL.NACK_ADDR_AFTER_TIMEOUT`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Target Timeout.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_NACK_COUNT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target NACK Count Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_NACK_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the number of transactions NACKed by this target since the last read of this register, saturating at 255. This field can be used to track how many transactions were missed when the Target RX FIFO is full.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_ACK_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target ACK Control Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NBYTES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
When `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`, writing to this register specifies the number of bytes this target should ACK. The count decrements per byte ACKed. Effective only when `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.
This control field is used to implement SMBus's mid-transfer (N)ACK responses.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`, writing `1` to this field causes this target to NACK all bytes of the transaction. Effective only when `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ACQ_FIFO_NEXT_DATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO Next Byte Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: This field contains the next byte to be pushed into the Target RX FIFO, allowing software to decide whether to accept or reject it. Valid only when `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_NACK_HANDLER_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller NACK Timeout Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timeout value (specified in system clock cycles) for this controller Mode to automatically STOP a transaction when `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.NACK` is set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables Controller NACK Timeout.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_EVENTS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller Events Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to an unexpected NACK sent by the target. This behavior can be disabled by writing `1` to `FDATA.NAKOK`. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNHANDLED_NACK_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to a Controller NACK Timeout. See `HOST_NACK_HANDLER_TIMEOUT` for details. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUS_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to a Bus Timeout. See `TIMEOUT_CTRL` for details. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ARBITRATION_LOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the controller has halted due to it losing an arbitration against another controller. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_EVENTS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target Events Register (Target Mode)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_PENDING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the target is stretching the clock due to receiving a READ address byte and waiting for software to confirm the release of the Target TX FIFO data. Valid only if `CTRL.TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN = 1`. See `CTRL.TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN` for details. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUS_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this target has halted due a Bus Timeout terminating a READ transaction. See `TIMEOUT_CTRL` for details. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ARBITRATION_LOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that a controller has lost arbitration, causing a READ transaction to end. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: START_DETECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start Detect Flag (Target Mode only). Set to 1 by hardware when a START (or repeated START) is detected while `CTRL.ENABLETARGET = 1`. Cleared when software writes 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP_DETECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stop Detect Flag (Target Mode only). Set to 1 by hardware when a STOP is detected while `CTRL.ENABLETARGET = 1`. Cleared when software writes 1.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SMBUS_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SMBus Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBSUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: indicates that the `smbsus_ni` input is asserted.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: indicates that the `smbalert_ni` input is asserted.
